apollo11-lm.notes: Video is now 30 s: descent 787-799 s of HQ-194, then the window view after landing (808-826 s). Contact light is placed at the visual touchdown (about 10 s in). Two stretches were cut from the audio: the ~5 s silence before 'Contact light' and the checklist chatter between 'Engine stop' and 'Houston, Tranquility Base here'. The PAO loop can carry a NASA commentator; I could not listen-check that none is audible here.
apollo11-lm.audio: Real radio: Aldrin calls out the last seconds ('4 forward... drifting to the right a little... contact light... engine stop'), then Armstrong says 'Houston, Tranquility Base here. The Eagle has landed' and Charlie Duke answers 'You got a bunch of guys about to turn blue.'

cues.text: Okay. Neil, we can see you coming down the ladder now.
I'm at the foot of the ladder.
Okay. I'm going to step off the LM now.
That's one small step for man…

apollo11-replay.notes: Built from four cuts of the PAO loop at 421.8-426.6 s, 473.3-476.1 s, 492.3-495.1 s and 517.7-526.6 s (GET 109:22:46, 109:23:38, 109:24:12, 109:24:23). Long silences were removed. Line 2 is only the first sentence of Armstrong's description, cut at his first pause. Line 4 is split at Armstrong's pause: 'one giant leap' starts at 15.9 s (measured from the file's loudness), so the caption changes when the words do. Cue times come from where speech starts in the file; texts follow the ALSJ transcript, where the Houston speaker is CAPCOM Bruce McCandless.
